content.text: {"id": "mm5312a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Safety-belt use was higher in states with primary laws (85.3%; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 84.9%--85.7%)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "prevalence of self-reported safety-belt use was higher among states with primary laws (85.3%)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "prevalence of always using a safety belt ranged from 52.4% in North Dakota to 92.2% in California"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the prevalence of never using a safety belt among states with secondary laws (4.1%; 95% CI = 3.9%--4.3%)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "state-based, random-digit--dialed telephone survey"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence estimates were weighted to represent the state and territorial populations."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "SUDAAN was used to account for the complex sampling design."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Respondents who never drove or rode in cars, refused to respond, or responded \"don't know\" (n = 807) were excluded from all analyses."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
